name: How long does bathroom vanity installation usually take?
description: Most vanity installs take a few hours to a full day, depending on plumbing changes, removal work, and whether the countertop or sink needs fitting.

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom vanity installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bathroom vanity installation usually takes **a few hours to a full day**, depending on whether the old vanity must be removed, plumbing needs to be adjusted, or the new top and sink need fitting. If you want a faster turnaround in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, or Parker, have the vanity, top, sink, and faucet ready before the installer arrives. A simple swap is often quicker than a full custom setup.
